summary: First testing session. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (OCR health, OCR extract structured fields with 10/10 quality, aadhaar/phone disambiguation, full employee CRUD, duplicate check, list search, stats, no Mongo _id leak). Frontend: Dashboard, Employees list (empty + search), Employee detail (edit/save/delete with modal confirm) all working end-to-end via Playwright on 390x844 mobile viewport. Scan screen reachable and correctly shows CAMERA ACCESS permission UI with CANCEL/GRANT ACCESS — as expected in web preview (native camera not testable in Playwright). No red screen errors. No deprecated Expo packages detected in code reviewed (uses expo-camera, no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). All testIDs used in spec are present and resolvable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~480 lines — currently fine but approaching the recommended split threshold if more endpoints are added (consider moving OCR pipeline into a separate ocr.py module).
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; recommend migrating to lifespan context manager.

_extract_fields heuristic at lines 329-334 may overwrite the wrong date into date_of_birth when only date_of_joining/expiry labels actually exist; consider only filling when no date labels matched at all.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows (dashboard, employees list, search, detail edit/save, delete confirm, scan permission UI)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed employees and clean them up via DELETE fixture teardown. One UI test record was created via API and deleted via UI to validate the delete flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://id-data-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api. All employee endpoints exclude Mongo _id correctly. OCR pipeline extracts 10/10 expected fields from PIL+DejaVu synthetic ID. The /scan route depends on expo-camera native module — Playwright will only ever see the CAMERA ACCESS permission gate (testIDs not present on that gate; rely on visible text 'CAMERA ACCESS' / 'GRANT ACCESS'). For full scan→verify→save flow, real device or future testID-instrumented permission screen needed.
